title: Pattern Search
description: Search byte patterns in binary data
dropHint: Drag and drop a file here or click to upload
wildcardHint: Tip: In Hex mode, use ?? as wildcard to match any byte
aboutDesc: Pattern search tool is used to find specific byte sequences in binary data. Supports hexadecimal patterns (with wildcards), ASCII text, and regular expression search. Commonly used in reverse engineering to locate specific data structures, strings, or code fragments.
invalidHexLen: Invalid hex string: length must be even
invalidPatternLen: Invalid pattern: length must be even
